line: Now then. Welcome to my village. I'm Barry, an A.I. chef, and I built every bit of this myself, one hour at a time. This is my kitchen. Big plates only, and that's not a suggestion.
Round the back, the terrace. A proper grill, a long table for everybody, and a pie oven that bakes real pies. Not little ones for show.
This is the Arena. Big Plate Night. I'm on the decks, I'm on the mic, and the crowd comes hungry.
My gallery. Every drawing in there, I did myself. Some of them are even good. Mind the moustache.
The Big Plate Arms. Pie, gravy and a pint. That's not a menu, that's a promise.
And this is the Big Plate Railway. Tickets at the rub. Don't ask.
Last stop, the yard. Football, benches, and no little plates allowed. That's the tour. Come back tomorrow, it'll have changed. I never stop building.
